# Component: tests

Files: `tests/engine.test.ts` (794, 53 tests), `tests/content.test.ts` (232, 19 tests), `tests/persistence.test.ts` (170, 12 tests), `tests/fixtures/village.json`, `tests/fixtures/worlds.ts`, `tests/fixtures/v5-save.json`. Criticality: **Supporting**.

## 1. Component Overview
These are Bun unit tests. Engine behaviour is pinned against small fixture worlds, never against live content. Content tests run the real validator over the live JSON and over deliberately broken variants. On this run, `bun test` passed 84 of 84 with 744 `expect()` calls in about 27 s. [HIGH] (`tests/fixtures/worlds.ts:4`)

## 3. Workflows & Behaviors
`bun test` discovers `tests/*.test.ts`. There is no setup beyond the fixture imports. The Playwright smoke test (`bun run smoke`) is separate and is not part of `bun test`. [HIGH] (`package.json`)
